pages.text: Costs one ability slot, a dragon horn, a nether star, a compass and one heart from each dragon species. Open Tactical Deployment from the dragon roster to view a 128×128 area, starting zoomed to 65×65 with a dynamic scale bar. Right-click terrain to deploy the selected stored dragon, or right-click one of your deployed dragons to recall it; left-click your dragon, then pick a destination or target. Esc returns to the roster.
